Built **Wildbound** in `index.html` as a complete, playable browser game. Start it with `python3 -m http.server 3002` and open `http://localhost:3002`.

It includes three stages with distinct scenery and synthesized music, three selectable classes, health and mana, enemies, rolling, running, jumping, climbing, attacks, skills, and wildlife. Boss fights use telegraphed attack zones so players can dodge before each strike. Keyboard and mobile touch controls are supported.

I made a lightweight, self-contained 2D game using Canvas rather than external art assets. Verified the game loads and runs in-browser, checked JavaScript syntax, and saved a gameplay screenshot at `screenshots/wildbound.jpg`.
